integrity: An unbounded elementary proof is supplied; finite regression is not an infinite proof. Earlier unindexed literature may exist; external peer review was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only in the valuation-one even residue class when the odd successor has at most three prime factors with multiplicity; no claim for other inputs, nor existence of further consecutive equal values.
title: Complete low-factor neighbor classification for alternating divisor sums at the exact 2-adic layer
